title: Rhea Ripley - 'WWE Isn't The Same Without Bianca Belair Around' - NewsBreak
text:
By Ryan Clark ,
32 minutes ago
Rhea Ripley recently opened up about how much the WWE women’s division has been missing Bianca Belair, noting that things haven’t felt the same during her absence.
Belair has been sidelined for close to a year after suffering a serious hand injury at WrestleMania 41. The bout — which also featured IYO SKY — stood out as one of the night’s highlights, but it came at a cost. What initially appeared to be a minor finger issue turned out to be far more severe.
READ MORE: Did Liv Morgan Party Too Hard At Coachella?
READ MORE: PHOTO – Concerning Nikki Bella Update Just Days Before WWE WrestleMania 42
Speaking during a recent appearance on the “Shak Wrestling” podcast, Ripley admitted that Belair’s absence has left a void, both on-screen and behind the scenes. She said,
“It’s honestly not the same without Bianca there. I miss her. I hope that she comes back soon, but at the same time, I also hope she’s living her best life, not having to go to work for a little bit. She’s busted her a** for so long. They’ve literally made her do so much and work so much. She deserves the time off.”
She added, “I wish it was under better circumstances because that finger be looking nasty. It’s shocked me that she’s been out for nearly a year from a finger injury. Something that seems so small is something that’s so big. And I’ve seen the photos. She sent me the photos, so thank you, Bianca. They’re pretty gnarly looking. I just really hope that she comes back soon.”
